column1: # verb_first.tsv -- one surface per row. hazm 0.12.1 words.dat (MIT) tags each
# as a noun or adjective only, yet in subtitles it is almost always a verb form,
# so the verb tables answer it before words.dat does (tokenizer._classify).
# Counts are hermitdave FrequencyWords 2018 fa_50k (OpenSubtitles), every yeh
# and kaf spelling summed after fa_normalize: 185,342 tokens between them.
# Everywhere else a tagged row still wins (plan probe P-9: mard, dasht, dad,
# saxt, shekast, xast and konad stay nouns). kist is no verb (ki + ast).
